info.title: Less Common Causes of Hearing Loss
info.subtitle: Beyond age and noise, these are worth knowing

rows.title: Ototoxic medications
rows.desc: Some antibiotics, chemo drugs, and high-dose aspirin

rows.title: Otosclerosis
rows.desc: Abnormal middle-ear bone growth, often inherited

rows.title: Autoimmune & Ménière's
rows.desc: Fluctuating or lopsided loss, sometimes with vertigo

rows.title: Sudden hearing loss
rows.desc: A sharp one-ear drop is a same-day emergency
